## Task

Add your developer profile to the `contributors/` directory in a new Markdown
file named `contributors/YOUR-GITHUB-USERNAME.md`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] I created a new file using my GitHub username.
- [ ] I followed `contributors/template.md`.
- [ ] I did not edit another contributor's file or the shared template.
- [ ] I created a feature branch for this task.
- [ ] I used a Conventional Commit message.
- [ ] I pushed my branch to my fork.
- [ ] I opened a Pull Request against the original repository's `main` branch.
- [ ] My Pull Request includes `Closes #ISSUE_NUMBER`.

## Notes

Ask questions in this issue if you need clarification.
